name: 🐟 Bomb Fishing!
desc:
Throw bombs into the lake and discover crazy hidden fish! 🐟
From common catches to ultra SECRET fish, every explosion could change your luck.

💥 Features:

Tons of unique fish to collect
Secret & ultra rare fish
Mutations: Normal, Golden, Diamond & more
Steal fish from other players 😈
Show off your rarest catches
Global leaderboards 🏆

Will you become the #1 Bomb Fisher? 🎣💣
